overview.mission: Help salaried Indians put idle savings to work without learning finance.
overview.problem: Money sits idle in savings accounts earning below inflation. People know they are losing value but do not trust or understand the alternatives.
overview.audience: Salaried professionals aged 25-40 in Indian metros with idle balances in savings accounts.
overview.solution: A guided layer over existing accounts that moves idle balances into better-yielding, low-risk instruments with plain-language explanations.
overview.value: Better returns on money you already have, without moving banks, picking funds, or learning jargon.
overview.direction: Narrowing to one segment and proving willingness to pay before locking pricing. Idea still pending mentor approval.

feedback.text: Users don't immediately understand why this is better than existing alternatives.
Mentor: the sizing needs a bottom-up build, not a top-down percentage of the market.
Interviewees keep asking where their money physically sits — address custody on slide 4.
Deck opening was too slow in the first read-through. Lead with the problem.

meetings.title: Idea pressure test
meetings.agenda: Problem statement, who is hurting, why now
meetings.notes: Problem statement still too broad. Narrowed to salaried 25-40 with idle savings.
meetings.decisions: Narrow the target segment before sizing.
meetings.actionItems: Aditya to redo sizing bottom-up; Kushal to add 5 more interviews.

meetings.title: Standup
meetings.notes: CFO blocked on CAC. Demo scope still open.
meetings.decisions: Submit for approval today even with model pending.

decisions.title: Go with Money-Mitra as the venture
decisions.reasoning: Strongest overlap between the team's finance and AI skills and a problem we can evidence with interviews in two weeks.
decisions.alternatives: Campus logistics marketplace; AI study planner.
decisions.consequences: Commits research and demo effort to fintech. Regulatory questions become a standing risk.

decisions.title: Narrow target to salaried 25-40 with idle savings
decisions.reasoning: Broad "everyone with a bank account" framing collapsed under questioning. This segment is reachable and has a measurable idle balance.
decisions.consequences: Sizing and interview script both get rewritten. Interview count resets to 15.

decisions.title: No live API calls during the demo
decisions.reasoning: Venue wifi is unreliable and a failed call on stage costs more than a slightly less impressive demo.
decisions.alternatives: Live demo with mobile hotspot fallback.
decisions.consequences: Demo must be pre-seeded and run offline. Adds two days of build work.

decisions.title: Hold pricing decision until interviews close
decisions.reasoning: Pricing set before willingness-to-pay evidence would be guesswork the judges will catch.
decisions.alternatives: Pick take-rate now and defend it.
decisions.consequences: Revenue model v1 slips to Sep 26. Deck skeleton waits on it.
